source.note: Wave-1 row 60 named the Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs Velociraptor on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is the same Quaternius dinosaur pack (Dec 2018) from its itch.io page, CC0, fetched as for the t-rex; the pack has one velociraptor. Height is the film raptor, not the fossil: 1.8 m to the head top in the horizontal rest pose puts the hips at ~1.0 m and the length at 4.5 m, the Jurassic Park-style animal audiences expect when a film says 'velociraptor' (it is really Deinonychus-sized). A true Velociraptor is ~0.5 m at the hip, turkey-sized; scale the model by 0.5 (head top 0.9 m) for that.
